scope: localized mild redness, itching, or irritation after contact with a soap, plant, cosmetic, or detergent; no airway or systemic signs
patterns: my hands are itchy after a new soap
a detergent made my skin red
small rash where a bandage was
skin burns a little after a new lotion
touched a plant and now that spot itches
child has redness from a new sunscreen
skin irritated by a cleaning product
itchy neck from a new fabric
response: Stop using the suspected product and gently rinse the area with cool water. Avoid scratching and do not put more of the same product on the skin. A pharmacist can advise on a suitable soothing product if it does not settle.
red_flags: swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or any breathing problem
rash spreading quickly, blistering, or very painful
eyes or inside of the mouth involved
suspected chemical burn or unknown substance
